aliases: Greystone greenhouse CO2 RH temperature sensor
applies_to: Greystone GH series horticulture (greenhouse / grow room) sensors measuring temperature, humidity and CO2, with BACnet MS/TP.
summary: The GH is a Greystone grow-room sensor for temperature, RH and CO2 with native BACnet MS/TP. The three readings are Analog Inputs; offsets and two configurable alarms (setpoint, hysteresis, delay) are Analog Values, and Multi-State Values assign each alarm to CO2, temperature or RH high/low and set the display.
notes: Points from the object table on page 1 of the setup guide.
The alarm setpoint and hysteresis ranges and defaults change with the alarm assignment (e.g. CO2 High 600-4000 ppm, default 1500; Temp High 10-40 °C, default 30).
Relay objects report a fault when the relay option is not fitted.
Multistate objects are MSV in the guide; listed here as MV. Access from the PICS: AV, BV and MSV Present_Value are writable.

source.title: GH Series Horticulture Sensor - Setup Guide BACnet Communication

integration.summary: Set the MS/TP MAC in the menu, then read temperature, RH and CO2 (AI 1-3). If the relays drive equipment, set the alarm assignment and setpoint once and monitor the alarm BIs.
setup: Device instance defaults to 381003 (381000 + MAC 3); it stops following the MAC once written over BACnet.
MAC address and baud are set in the local menu.
gotchas: Relay test BVs force the relay on and stay there until written back to 0.
Change MV 3/MV 4 before the alarm setpoints: the allowed setpoint range depends on the assignment.
